node.title: Comal
node.subtitle: I built a React PWA and Rails API to make weekly meal planning easier. Meals saved in the library can be added to a weekly menu and turned into a shopping list.

node.title: Greda
node.subtitle: I built Greda to give React apps a shared set of components and CSS tokens. Apps can compose and theme those components, and Storybook lets developers try them before integrating them.

node.title: Productos Dogar
node.subtitle: A Spanish-language site for regional sauces and chile blends, with a product catalog, recipes, and a guide to where to buy them. Built with Next.js and Greda.

node.title: This Portfolio
node.subtitle: My personal site for projects, writing, and my résumé. Built with Gatsby and React and hosted on GitHub Pages.
